source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-06: The Crashing Wave

items.name: Blood Scent
items.text: The shark can smell blood in the water from up to 1 mile away.

items.name: Breach
items.text: The shark Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leaps vertically out of the water up to 15 feet high, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 20 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the shark splashes back down into the water.

items.name: Savage
items.text:
Requirements The shark hit with a jaws Strike on its most recent action this turn.

---

Effect The creature the shark hit takes 1d10 slashing damage
